script.name: Console commands
script.description: Runs the console commands typed in the panel against the server's HTTP API (status, players, say <message>, save): the server reads no console input and has no RCON.

script.name: Save the world and shut down
script.description: Asks the server to save the world and exit (HTTP API /saveandexit, SIGINT on Linux when the API does not answer) and waits until it exits.

script.name: Save the world
Keep config edits made while running (before write)
script.description: While the server runs, keeps a copy of a config file before the panel writes it (the server overwrites Game.ini and Engine.ini from memory when it exits).

script.name: Keep config edits made while running (after write)
script.description: While the server runs, records the settings a panel edit changed; the stop script writes them again after the server has exited.

script.name: Prepare the server
script.description: Clears config edits recorded during the previous run. Linux: makes the server binaries executable (the Steam download drops the exec bit) and installs steamclient.so in ~/.steam/sdk64 (the Steam game server API needs it).
